Jennifer Arkowitz, who practices law in San Francisco, California, was selected to Rising Stars for 2013 - 2015. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Rising Stars selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.

Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at University of California College of the Law, San Francisco (formerly UC Hastings). She graduated in 2004. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 2005.
